tagline: A high jumper who found his speed.
headline: Texas Track & Field · 400m · 4x400m Relay

school.name: The University of Texas at Austin

bio.short: Sihle Mahlangu is a 400m sprinter for Texas from Wolmaransstad, South Africa. A former youth high jumper, he won World U20 relay silver for South Africa in 2024 and ran for Texas at the 2026 NCAA Championships. He studies Economics and was a 2026 Feniex Project Manager Intern.
long: Mahlangu is a 400m runner whose best is 46.02. In August 2024, still in his final year of school, he ran the second leg for South Africa at the World Athletics U20 Championships in Lima, Peru. His 45.50 split, the third-fastest of the night, moved the team from fifth to second, and South Africa took silver in 3:05.22. As a Texas freshman in 2025-26 he ran on the 4x400m relay that earned an automatic NCAA berth in 3:02.12, raced at the NCAA Championships in Eugene, and ran college bests from 21.37 in the 200m to 1:53.13 in the 800m.

He was born in Wolmaransstad and moved to Potchefstroom at the start of grade 10 to attend Potchefstroom Gimnasium. He began as a high jumper at age 10 and won national youth medals before an injury ended his jumping in 2022. His coaches moved him to the sprints. In his words: "We didn't realize how fast I was until 2023." He grew up in a Tswana community, went to Afrikaans schools and speaks English most of the time. At Texas he studies Economics and made the 2026 USTFCCCA All-Academic Team in his first season.

Mahlangu has said his long-term goal is to compete as an Olympian while building a career in business and leadership. His 2026 Project Manager Internship at Feniex Industries, the Austin manufacturer of emergency-vehicle lighting, sirens and controllers, put the second half of that plan to work. An Economics student who has already rebuilt his sport once, he brings a relay runner's habits to project work: knowing his leg, owning it, and handing off clean to the next person in line.

inTheirWords.quote: In the long run, my biggest dream is to become a consistent Olympian while thriving in the business and leadership world.
I've learned that self-belief is crucial; without it, failure is inevitable.
The plan was gold, but we're still proud of the silver.

resume.summary: Economics student and Texas Track & Field sprinter; 2024 World U20 4x400m relay silver medallist for South Africa. Project Manager Intern at Feniex Industries (2026). Works comfortably across languages and cultures and brings an athlete's discipline to schedules, handoffs and accountability.

bullets: Tracked project schedules, milestones and open items for cross-functional work at an American manufacturer of emergency-vehicle lighting, sirens and controllers.
Organized project data and timelines in spreadsheets to keep cost and schedule information visible to project owners.
Supported coordination between engineering, production and sales teams, keeping status current as work moved forward.
Documented processes and used AI tools, including Claude, to summarize information and draft project materials.
